description: List roadmap items (blog topics queued for writing). Ignored (hidden) items are left out unless you pass status="ignored" - use that to see what the search-data reconcile hid as already covered, or what was dismissed (hiddenReason says why; call seo_roadmap_edit action=restore to bring one back). type="refresh" lists items that rewrite an EXISTING page that ranks poorly for real search queries (they overwrite that article in place). Returns short detail by default: {id, title, status} per item. Use detail="medium" for the compact summary (type, priority, primaryKeywords, clusterId, brief {briefId, status, operationId, error}, and when present searchEvidence, refreshPageUrl, hiddenReason, userOverride) or detail="full" for raw objects (metadata.searchEvidence, metadata.refresh with queries + answerQuestions, metadata.hiddenReason, metadata.userOverride). Call seo_roadmap_get with detail="full" for a single item's complete detail.

clusterId.description: Filter to one cluster ID from seo_list_clusters

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

status.description: Filter by status. Omit for everything except ignored items.

type.description: Filter by item type. "refresh" = rewrite of an existing page.

name: seo_list_roadmap
